info.schedule: Selected first Tuesdays (2026: May 5 and Nov 3), Superior Court Plaza, Marietta
info.note: The November 3, 2026 list is posted about four weeks before the sale. Prior sales come from the excess funds list, which names the buyer.

auction.venue: Superior Court Plaza, Cobb County Superior Court
auction.address: Corner of Haynes Street and Washington Avenue (Cobb Superior Court, 70 Haynes Street), Marietta, GA 30090
auction.time: First Tuesday of months with a scheduled sale, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm (first Wednesday if the date is a holiday); bidder cards issued 9:00 am to 10:00 am
auction.registration: You must pre-register online before the day of the sale; bidding is in person only. Bidder cards are issued by the Levy Officer from 9:00 am to 10:00 am on sale day with a valid photo ID.
auction.payment: Cash or certified check (the booklet also lists cashier's check) payable to Cobb County Tax Commissioner. Payment in full is required upon conclusion of the tax sale.
auction.office: Cobb County Tax Commissioner's Office, Property Tax Division
auction.office_address: 736 Whitlock Ave, Ste. 100, Marietta, GA 30064 (mail: P.O. Box 100127, Marietta, GA 30061-7027)
vital: The tax deed, not the property, is sold; Cobb does not sell tax liens and takes no mail, phone or fax bids.
Opening bid is the tax due plus penalties and all other applicable costs.
The buyer cannot take possession, improve the property or evict tenants; the owner may redeem within 12 months by paying the bid plus a 20% premium (10% for each additional year).
Properties that get no bid may be re-auctioned that afternoon at 3:00 pm.
The sale list is published about four weeks before the sale on the website and on Fridays in the Marietta Daily Journal.
Excess funds may be paid into Superior Court by interpleader for distribution (O.C.G.A. 48-4-5).
